body.name: zero-coverage response-boundary singleton experiment class
body.construction:
Let \(b_n=\min\{1/4,1/\log(n+1)\}\), so this is the requested sequence \(1/\log(n+1)\) after a finite-row adjustment.  Let \(\kappa_n\downarrow0\) satisfy \(\kappa_n\leq1/4\).  On \(\mathcal C=\mathcal X=\{1,2\}\), define \(\mathbb P^0=(P_n^{\circ,0})_{n\geq1}\) as follows.  Row \(n\) contains \(n\) independent response-study observations \((W_i,Y_i)\), where \(W_i\) is uniform on \(\mathcal C\times\mathcal X\) and
\[
Y_i\mid W_i=(c,x)\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(2b_n/n).
\]
The deployment margins are observed without error and satisfy \(p_n=r_n=(1/2,1/2)\), while \(\pi_{n,cx}=1/4\) and \(\mu_{n,cx}=2b_n/n\) for every \((c,x)\).  If \(\overline Y_{n,cx}\) is the within-cell response proportion, set it to zero when the cell is empty and define
\[
\widehat\mu_{n,cx}=\left(1-\frac{2b_n}{n}\right)\overline Y_{n,cx}+\frac{b_n}{n}.
\]
The multiplier draw is the empirical-influence multiplier for these four response estimators and has zero margin coordinates.  Define \(\mathfrak Q_{\kappa}=\{\mathbb P^0\}\).
